# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are developed on the current `dev` branch. The latest available
JB Search release or development snapshot is supported; older releases and
historical snapshots do not receive separate fixes. Please update to the latest
available version before reporting, when practical.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately to the maintainer at
[idfedorov09fb@gmail.com](mailto:idfedorov09fb@gmail.com). Do not open a public
issue or discussion for an undisclosed vulnerability.

Include the affected JB Search and VS Code versions, your operating system and
local or remote environment, a description of the impact, and steps to reproduce
when available. Redact credentials and private source code from your report.
The maintainer will review the report and coordinate follow-up and disclosure
with you. Response times depend on maintainer availability.
